dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast white patch/band visible on the median or greater coverts, appearing thick and prominent against the dark ground color.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Narrow, distinct pale edges visible along the boundaries of the folded secondary and primary feathers.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible transverse barred pattern on the rectrices consisting of alternating high-contrast dark and light bands.
